notes: Read the 148-line source hook line by line before editing and preserved every exported type, option field, context field, resolver helper, optimistic cache snapshot, rollback, invalidation, success, error, and settled callback behavior.

Source is non-visual TanStack Query utility code; the native output imports only @tanstack/react-query and contains no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI component imports.

Replaced the web @/lib/queryBroadcast dependency with a native-safe local invalidation shim and an explicit nativeOptimisticMutationCapabilities.queryBroadcastAvailable=false export because React Native has no browser-tab BroadcastChannel equivalent.
The broadcast option remains accepted so existing callers keep the same API surface; on native it invalidates local TanStack Query caches rather than attempting unavailable cross-tab broadcast.
